title: Unofficial SC Scrap Metal Index item array

defName.description: Internal definition code. Primary identity together with kind; use it for lookup.

kind.description: Registry item family, such as ship or module.

name_en.description: English identifying name; empty when unresolved.

name_ru.description: Russian identifying name; empty when unresolved.

label_en.description: English name with distinguishing tier, rank and variant parts; raw code when unnamed.

label_ru.description: Russian distinguishing display label; raw code when unnamed.

name_status.description: Trust vocabulary: exact (direct key), own_field (own definition field), prefixed (known key prefix), category (shared subtype), derived (our derivation), none (unresolved). Category and derived are not exact item titles.

short_desc_en.description: English description, whitespace normalized, at most 200 Unicode characters, or empty. Own short description, own description, then category description. Long candidates are skipped. No lore.

short_desc_ru.description: Russian description selected independently with the same limit and fallback order.

desc_status.description: Same vocabulary as name_status. If language sources differ, the more general status wins: category, derived, prefixed, own_field, exact. none means both descriptions are empty. Per-language provenance is retained by the local build.

desc_has_placeholders.description: Boolean: either description contains a raw $value$ placeholder. Values are never substituted.

race.description: Raw static race code, for example ai.Race.EMPIRE; empty if unavailable.

rank.description: Static numeric rank or empty; never inferred from tier.

tier.description: Static numeric tier or empty; never converted to rank.

storeItemId.description: Own definition ID or empty. NOT unique: lookup by kind and defName. Expressions and inherited IDs stay blank.

storeId.description: Store XML identifier or empty; a separate namespace from storeItemId.

atlasId.description: Atlas identifier or empty; a separate namespace from store and account instance IDs.

storeItemId_shared.description: Boolean: another row in the full registry shares this nonempty storeItemId; includes shared defaults and zero.

account_scope.description: account, npc_or_internal, or unknown. Main items files contain account only. unknown means scope is unestablished. Account classification does not prove grantability.

defined_in.description: Standard relative install location and physical line: star conflict\data\gamedata\def\ex\ship.lua:26711. Resolve under your Steam installation.

db_fields.description: Database field paths where this item was seen in a sample database, e.g. cosmosim_<WinUser>.accounts.vessels[].defName. Only a confirmation: where an item of a kind CAN be stored is in data/db_by_kind.csv. Numeric sample attachment indices become <>.

flags.description: Registry diagnostic code list, such as no_name or xml_only; retained independently of improved names.

race_en.description: English race or group name from the game string tables (race_<CODE>), e.g. Empire; empty if the item has no race code.

race_ru.description: Russian race or group name from the game string tables, e.g. Империя.
